ideas.name: Pre-Refunding Treasury Gains
ideas.claim: Longer-maturity U.S. Treasuries show positive returns on the day before quarterly Treasury refunding announcements.
ideas.quote: Treasury bonds earn substantial positive returns on the day before TRAs.
ideas.mechanism: The paper attributes the pre-announcement price movement in part to reduced uncertainty around Treasury refunding announcements.

rules.timeframe: The day before each regularly scheduled quarterly Treasury refunding announcement
rules.entry: Long Treasuries on pre-announcement days; exact entry time not stated
rules.filters: Four regularly scheduled pre-announcement days per year

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports an annualized Sharpe ratio above 4 for the pre-announcement strategy in Treasury bonds with maturities of at least two years, before transaction costs.
required_data: Historical Treasury bond prices or returns by maturity
Historical quarterly Treasury refunding announcement dates
